Foundation and DINO encoders prepare their own input and ignore it.

records.source: how a timm backbone's input is prepared. ``"pretrained"`` resizes each crop to the model's pretrained input size and standardises it by the model's pretrained mean and standard deviation (ImageNet's for ImageNet weights), as the model was trained. ``"none"`` feeds the [0, 1] crops at their own size. records.translation: como a entrada de um backbone timm é preparada. ``"pretrained"`` redimensiona cada recorte para o tamanho de entrada pré-treinado do modelo e o padroniza pela média e pelo desvio padrão pré-treinados do modelo (os do ImageNet para pesos ImageNet), tal como o modelo foi treinado. ``"none"`` fornece os recortes em [0, 1] no seu próprio tamanho. records.context: Embed an extracted image region store into per-cell embeddings and per-microplate sample position aggregates.
records.label: spacr.embeddings.embed_store#0
records.source: Embed a crop store into per-cell embeddings and per-well aggregates.
records.translation: Gera embeddings por célula e agregados por poço a partir de um armazenamento de recortes.

records.context: One fixed scale per channel is estimated from a random sample of the whole store (the 99th percentile of 2,048 extracted image regions) and every extracted image region is divided by it, so a cell's embedding does not depend on which extracted image regions share its batch. The extracted image regions are encoded in chunks on CPU worker processes, then averaged per microplate sample position: the mean and the median of every dimension, with the number of cells.
records.label: spacr.embeddings.embed_store#1
records.source: One fixed scale per channel is estimated from a random sample of the whole store (the 99th percentile of 2,048 crops) and every crop is divided by it, so a cell's embedding does not depend on which crops share its batch. The crops are encoded in chunks on CPU worker processes, then averaged per well: the mean and the median of every dimension, with the number of cells.
records.translation: Uma escala fixa por canal é estimada a partir de uma amostra aleatória de todo o armazenamento (o percentil 99 de 2.048 recortes) e cada recorte é dividido por ela, de modo que o embedding de uma célula não depende de quais recortes compartilham o seu lote. Os recortes são codificados em blocos em processos de trabalho de CPU e depois agregados por poço: a média e a mediana de cada dimensão, com o número de células.
